evidence_items.summary: RoboTeam Videos Recordings of AI agents controlling teams of robot arms in the RoboTeam benchmark. Project page · Code · Paper RoboTeam is a simulated factory hall where language models control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time, from camera images alone. evidence_items.title: allenai/RoboTrack-Bench
evidence_items.summary: RoboTrack-Bench RoboTrack-Bench is a benchmark for point tracking on real manipulation video. It has 307 clips of robots and people handling objects, with 2,522 hand-annotated point tracks. Each track gives a point's position and visibility in every frame. Clips average 223 frames, and 57% of the points are occluded at least once. Quick Links 💻 Code: allenai/robotrack 🤖 Models: RoboTracker, RoboTracker-Warp (non-commercial) 📂 Datasets: RoboTrack-Bench… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/RoboTrack-Bench.

evidence_items.title: Damin3927/SWEEP-Bench
evidence_items.summary: SWEEP-Bench demonstrations Training demonstrations for SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark of robot manipulation on a moving conveyor belt. There are 80 tasks in 16 skill categories, and each task is evaluated at 13 belt speeds from 0.10 to 0.40 m/s. This dataset has 200 successful scripted-expert demonstrations per task, 16,000 episodes and 1,259,153 frames in total, at 20 fps.
